text:
olivia: Morning riddle: who's been adding tiny googly eyes to desk plants overnight?
dan: guilty. It improves focus by 200% (citation: my cat).
tariq: Noted. Are we starting a 'plant witness protection' program or just accepting the new aesthetic?
kevin: Please tell me the monstera didn't get googly eyes. That's sacred.
dan: monstera is safe. I have only targeted the small succulents and one suspicious ficus.
olivia: Vote: keep the googly-eye movement or return plants to their natural stoic selves? :one: keep :two: restore
tariq: :one: keep. They look like tiny colleagues.
kevin: :two: restore. Also please stop putting tiny hats on the stapler. It was stressed.
hr-bot: Gentle reminder: modifications to office property should be non-destructive. If stapler shows signs of trauma, file a support ticket. (automated)
dan: noted hr-bot. I will limit accessories to removable items only. Caps will be elastic.
olivia: GIF: <link_to_googly_eye_plant.gif> caption: "New coworker onboarding"
tariq: Can we add a rule: if you decorate something, put your initials on the tag. Saves confusion and reduces passive-aggressive notes.
kevin: Agreed. Also a tiny sign near the plants that says 'googly eye consent: yes / no' maybe with sticky notes.
dan: I'll make consent stickers at lunch. Also, if anyone finds a tiny top hat, it's mine (for the stapler).
olivia: Meeting takeaway: accept light-hearted plant decorations with consent stickers, removable only, no hats on sensitive devices. Crafting hour Friday 3pm for sticker making and stapler therapy.
thar: (typo) meant tariq: I'm in for craft hour. Bringing extra eyes.
kevin: I'll bring coffee. No hat for stapler, but very small bow ties are permitted.
olivia: Thread closed unless stapler forms a union. :seedling: :eyes:
